We assess the performance of our framework using several key evaluation metrics. ROUGE assesses n-gram overlap with reference summaries, including R-1 (unigram), R-2 (bigram) and R-L (longest common subsequence). BERTScore (BS p, BS r, BS f1) evaluates similarity using BERT embeddings, where BS p represents precision, BS r recall and BS f1 the F1-score. BARTScore measures the quality of summaries by scoring them as conditional language generation tasks. Finally, we propose NARRATIVEFACTSCORE (NFS) as a novel metric to measure the factuality of the generated summaries.
